notes: three independent manufacturer sources converge on 0.80 mm as the minimum wall for silver lost-wax casting: materialise (src-0001, high-gloss finish, evid-wall-001), jfd jewelry (src-0004, silver and bronze, evid-wall-004), cooksongold (src-0010, structural/external walls, evid-wall-006). stuller (src-0011, evid-wall-007) confirms with 'must' language. gildform empirical tests (src-0019, evid-wall-008) establish 0.75 mm as production-safe empirically and 0.50 mm as marginal, bracketing the 0.80 mm threshold from below. contradiction-001 (materialise 0.60 mm gloss vs 0.80 mm high-gloss) is resolved for production use: the 0.80 mm high-gloss floor matches the practitioner consensus and sculptura targets production-quality output. the benchmark harness reproduced the threshold: wall-ladder rungs at 0.30, 0.50, 0.70 mm fire ctr-wall-001; rungs at 0.80, 1.00, 1.20 mm pass. pathological-p004 (0.30 mm slab) fires; pathological-p005 (exactly 0.80 mm band) passes. all verdicts matched in the witnessing run (31/31, exit 0).
